papers.title: Osteogenic Comparison on Selective Laser Melting Printed and Sandblasting-Acid-Etching Ti Substrates for Customized Implant Applications

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注SLM钛表面的成骨分化，未涉及应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，对骨整合方向有参考价值但缺乏力学评估。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate mechanical properties (static or fatigue), does not relate porous structure to stress shielding, and does not include implant-level mechanical testing or finite element analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM打印和SLA处理的钛基板对成骨分化的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备SLM和SLA处理的钛表面，进行细胞培养和成骨标记物检测。
summary_zh.result: SLM表面比SLA表面更能促进成骨分化。
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验验证成骨分化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the osteogenic potential of selective laser melting printed and sandblasted-acid-etched titanium substrates for customized implant applications.
summary_en.method: Titanium substrates were fabricated by selective laser melting and treated with sandblasting-acid-etching, and osteogenic differentiation of cells was assessed via in vitro assays.
summary_en.result: Selective laser melting-printed surfaces enhanced osteogenic differentiation compared to sandblasted-acid-etched surfaces.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments with osteogenic markers.

papers.title: Design of a composite bioink for bioprinting applications

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及生物墨水材料配方，未引入任何AI或机器学习方法。
llm.why_not_core: No AI/ML integration in any bioprinting workflow stage; purely experimental material design without computational modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发适用于生物打印的复合生物墨水
summary_zh.method: 通过混合不同材料制备复合生物墨水
summary_zh.result: 表征了墨水的流变性和生物相容性
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验验证生物相容性

summary_en.motivation: To develop a composite bioink with improved printability and biocompatibility for bioprinting applications.
summary_en.method: Composite bioinks were fabricated by blending natural and synthetic polymers.
summary_en.result: The optimized bioink exhibited suitable rheological properties and supported cell viability.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays confirmed biocompatibility of the printed constructs.

papers.title: Influence of selective laser melting mode on the structure and phase composition of Ti-Nb alloy
authors: Margarita A Khimich Anna Yu Eroshenko Zhanna G Kovalevskaya Alex

corresponding_authors.name: Margarita A Khimich Anna Yu Eroshenko Zhanna G Kovalevskaya Alex

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及Ti-Nb合金SLM加工的结构与相组成，未涉及应力遮挡、疲劳性能或骨整合等生物力学方向核心问题。
llm.why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding analysis, no osseointegration or surface morphology characterization, and no link to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM工艺对Ti-Nb合金组织和相组成的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用不同SLM模式制备Ti-Nb合金样品。
summary_zh.result: SLM模式显著影响合金的相组成和微观结构。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of selective laser melting mode on the microstructure and phase composition of Ti-Nb alloy.
summary_en.method: Ti-Nb samples were fabricated under different SLM parameters and characterized by XRD and SEM.
summary_en.result: The SLM mode significantly altered the phase fractions and grain morphology of the Ti-Nb alloy.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation beyond material characterization was performed.

papers.title: An improved biofabrication process to enhance cell survival and distribution in bioprinted scaffolds for cartilage regeneration

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文未涉及任何人工智能或机器学习方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper describes a process improvement for biofabrication but contains no AI/ML integration, model training, or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高生物打印支架中细胞的存活率和分布均匀性
summary_zh.method: 改进了生物制造工艺流程
summary_zh.result: 实现了细胞存活率和分布的显著提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance cell survival and spatial distribution in bioprinted scaffolds for cartilage tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: An improved biofabrication process was developed by optimizing printing parameters and materials.
summary_en.result: The modified process significantly increased cell viability and homogeneity within the scaffold.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments confirmed the improvements in cell outcomes.
